Accessibility audit results:

- **Tooling:** axe-core (WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A & AA + best-practice tags) run via jsdom against the full rendered page.
- **States tested:** all panels collapsed (initial), and all panels expanded (after clicking every trigger).
- **Violations:** 0 in both states.
- **Remediation:** none required — markup was already correct (semantic landmarks, single `<h1>`, `<button>` triggers with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls`, `hidden` panels, skip link, label/name match, sufficient contrast, reduced-motion + forced-colors handling).

Final files unchanged: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `script.js` in the working directory.

**Known limitations:** axe-core in jsdom cannot evaluate computed contrast (no layout/canvas), so contrast was verified by design (text `#1a1a1a` / muted `#5b5b5b` on `#ffffff`/`#f7f6f2`, accent `#6b4dff` on `#efeaff`, focus `#1f6feb`). Manual keyboard/SR walkthroughs and real-browser checks weren't performed in this environment.
